names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 iunie, «Sfântul Cuvios Gavriil din Kapsala».

floruit.note: The page dates the wonder it tells: the archangel's finger engraved the hymn on a slab of stone «pentru amintire imnul Maicii Domnului, Cuvine-se cu adevărat (980)». No year is given for his birth or his death, so the interval recorded is the century that year falls in.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
